description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Malzahar''' infects the target enemy's mind, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''[[File:Malzahar Call of the Void.png|20xpx|border|link=Malzahar#Call of the Void|An icon for Malzahar's ability Call of the Void]] [[Malzahar#Call of the Void|Call of the Void]]'' or ''[[File:Malzahar Nether Grasp.png|20xpx|border|link=Malzahar#Nether Grasp|An icon for Malzahar's ability Nether Grasp]] [[Malzahar#Nether Grasp|Nether Grasp]]''. ''Malefic Visions'' executes [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] if they would be damaged below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 10 – 30 (based on level) health.
description.text: Active: Malzahar infects the target enemy's mind, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with Call of the Void or Nether Grasp. Malefic Visions executes minions if they would be damaged below  10 – 30 (based on level) health.

description2.raw: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 2% of his '''maximum''' mana.
description2.text: If the target dies while infected, they spread Malefic Visions onto the closest nearby enemy and Malzahar restores  2% of his maximum mana.

notes.raw: * ''Malefic Visions'' deals [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|persistent damage]], additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect damage]], and applies [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. * ''Malefic Vision's'' cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time. ** The debuff is not applied if the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes.
notes.text:
Malefic Visions deals persistent damage, additionally tagged as indirect damage, and applies spell effects.
Malefic Vision's cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time.
* The debuff is not applied if the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes.
